prompt: You are an expert in clinical trials. Can you come up with a way to assess the similarity of clinical trial protocols
response: To assess the similarity of clinical trial protocols, you can use a simple algorithm that compares the key elements of each protocol. This algorithm could involve identifying common trial design elements like randomization, blinding, and interim analysis. Once similarities are identified, it could be possible to automatically generate a similarity score or report. This approach can quickly provide a quick assessment of protocol similarity.
